publisher: District of Columbia OCFO Real Property Tax Administration / DC GIS
notes: District of Columbia Tax Lots (assessment and taxation lots, A&T), polygon layer of about 30,867 features. SSL = Square-Suffix-Lot identifier. Layer has no owner, address or assessed value fields; those are in other OCFO datasets. STATEDAREA is square feet and CALCULATEDAREA is empty, so acres is not mapped.
